title: sarothamnus scoparius subsp. cantabricus
intro: Sarothamnus scoparius subsp. cantabricus, commonly known as Cantabric broom or Cantabricus broom, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has highlighted its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Sarothamnus scoparius subsp. cantabricus include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
